change_summary: Added a default-off BacktestEngine hook and real replay runner for ADDON_REQUIRE_IMPROVING_FOLLOWTHROUGH; the trigger improved versus no-add-on in all three fixed windows but failed to beat the ordinary strict 25% add-on candidate stably.

delta_metrics.gate4_vs_no_addon: directionally positive in 3/3 windows but below material production-promotion bar
delta_metrics.versus_normal_25pct_addon: late_strong improved, mid_weak regressed, old_thin was nearly flat; aggregate PnL -$8.11 vs normal add-on

hypothesis: Strict day-2 follow-through add-ons may improve if scheduled only when day-2 unrealized return and RS vs SPY both improve versus day 1.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage, so this deterministic lifecycle alpha branch was tested instead.

next_retry_requires: Do not retry day1-to-day2 improving unrealized/RS as the next add-on quality filter.
The ordinary strict day2 >= +2% and RS > 0 add-on remains the cleaner research candidate, still default-off because materiality is modest.
Future add-on work needs a different evidence type or forward sample, not another nearby day1/day2 improvement nudge.
notes: This was alpha_search, not measurement repair. One causal variable changed; production defaults remain unchanged.
rejection_reason: Rejected as a trigger-quality variant: it did not stably improve over the simpler strict 25% day-2 add-on and slightly reduced aggregate PnL versus that candidate. Do not promote this improvement filter or keep tuning nearby day1/day2 improvement variants.
